_comment: Plain white paper: printer and writing paper, book pages, notes, paper towel. Opaque, a matte dielectric fibre sheet, from an ambientCG scan (L3). Placed in engineered/composite as the wish list does: the class's boundary is not written yet (O11), so the home is provisional. The scan's albedo is brighter than Physically Based `Office Paper`; the authored tint brings its mean onto that entry. Carries the row's wear layers at 0 (C1): scuffs (overlay 1, damage) and dust as a deposit (overlay 2), gated by the Patches mask, whose channels fit that order (G damage patches, B deposit drifts); overlay 3 is empty, as the row has it. The row's damage layer, Creases01, is not made yet; Scuffs01 stands in for it in slot 1. Drafted by /matter-generate for the Kitchen_set look; Storm only, not rigged.
name: Paper_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.note: the scan's mean linear albedo (0.909, 0.900, 0.885) is tinted onto this entry's colour by the authored base_color_tint; its roughness map (mean ~0.63) is kept

sources.why: ambientCG gives no physical size for Paper001; a 1 cm tile puts its grain at a few hundredths of a millimetre, a paper's fibre.
